ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM5,
Residential Multi-Unit District, and B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District, symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 8-E in the area bound by:

      East 35th Street; South Giles Avenue; a line 423.5 feet south of and parallel to East 35th
      Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Giles Avenue; the alley next south of
      and parallel to East 35th Street; and, a line 79.85 feet east of and parallel to South Prairie
      Avenue

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                            Pat Dowell
                                                            Alderman, 3rd Ward




Common Address:
3500 South Giles Avenue
